title: Paul Muller confiscates and destroys Vallee's tracking tape
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Paul Muller confiscates and destroys Vallee's tracking tape, about early 1960s at French observatory, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: His superior at the observatory, Paul Muller, got a hold of the data. The next morning, Muller, who behaved like a petty army officer, simply confiscated the tape and destroyed it.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story from the early 1960s about Jacques Vallee, then a young worker at a French observatory who later became a well-known UFO researcher. According to Michels, Vallee had recorded tracking data of something in the sky on tape, and his boss, Paul Muller, whom Michels says acted like a petty army officer, took the tape the next morning and destroyed it. If true, it would mean early evidence of unknown objects was thrown away by the scientists themselves.
